# getDaysLeftInMonth

<link-summary>Returns how many days remain between a date and the end of its month.</link-summary>

<web-summary>getDaysLeftInMonth() — Returns how many days remain between a date and the end of its month. apps-script-utils, English.</web-summary>

<tldr>
<p>Module: <code>time</code> · Since: 1.11.0</p>
</tldr>

```typescript
function getDaysLeftInMonth(date: Date, inclusive: boolean = false): number;
```

The date itself is not counted: on the last day of a month the answer is `0`. It is the number of days still to come, which is what a quota or a billing period usually wants.

## Parameters

| Parameter                          | Type      | Description                                     |
| :--------------------------------- | :-------- | :---------------------------------------------- |
| `date`                             | `Date`    | The date to read. It must be a valid `Date`.    |
| `inclusive` _(optional)_ `= false` | `boolean` | Whether the given day counts towards the total. |

## Returns

`number` — the number of days left, `0` on the last day.

## Throws

| Exception                  | Condition                          |
| :------------------------- | :--------------------------------- |
| `IllegalArgumentException` | an argument is not a valid `Date`. |

## Examples

### Counting

```javascript
getDaysLeftInMonth(new Date(2026, 0, 20)); // => 11
```
